statement: Let (T, B) be an effective rational dlt pair on a globally strongly Q-factorial compact Kähler space, and put J = KT + B. Suppose there is an actual rational-line identity J ∼Q P + E, where P is analytically nef, E is an effective rational Cartier divisor, and, on one smooth compact Kähler resolution π : W → T projective over T, N(π∗ {J}) = π∗ E. There is a finite ordinary J-negative program to a nef model T′ which contracts precisely the prime components of E among the primes of T. Every step is P-trivial, with a fixed Cartier exponent as in Lemma 3.6, and JT′ ∼Q PT′ . If P is semiample, then so is this actual last adjoint.
